comparison: three-cohort metrics and per-user AP; paired deltas vs Stage 9; matched log-count minus binary differences; relevant-pair repeat50 partitions are diagnostic only
conditional_refit: only one qualifying winner; fresh full-history scalar and S9 factors; no CSV if none
controls: reuse Stage 9 and matched Stage 11 binary lambda/beta predictions; independently recompute their metrics, do not refit controls

fixed.B: column-wise -P_ij/P_jj, exact zero diagonal; negative coefficients retained
fixed.S9: exact Stage 9 adjusted repeat50/AR80, 70/30, no decay; no setting changes

fallback_and_ranking.fallback: cutoff-specific >=80% training popularity restricted to the applicable candidate pool
fallback_and_ranking.fusion: weighted sum of normalized scores; no score rounding
fallback_and_ranking.normalization: per-user max normalization over eligible candidate scores

fixed.fusion: (1-beta)*S9 + beta*normalized_positive_EASE; S9 is not additionally normalized
fixed.prediction: X_user @ B with weighted query rows; filter target candidates then clip completed scores and max-normalize positives
fixed.solver: Stage 11 Cholesky solve of G+lambda I against identity

hypothesis: preserving >=80% qualifying-airing frequency in EASE input may complement Stage 9 more effectively than binary EASE

input.axes: same positive support and learned axes as Stage 11; noncohort users and noncandidate historical programs included
input.convention: global normalization is an explicitly declared experiment convention, not standard paper preprocessing or proven optimal
input.count: number of distinct qualifying training user-airing interactions at >=80% actual observed coverage
input.degenerate: no positive entries => scale=0, empty X, no solve, all EASE scores zero, established fallback; no division by zero
input.duplicate_policy: unioned user-airing cache, deduplicate representations of (user_idx,airing_idx); distinct repeated airings each count once
input.scale_fit_scope: all qualifying training users/programs only, before cutoff; no labels or target data

only_change: training input representation relative to matched Stage 11 models
resources: same sequential fits, matrix memory estimate and fixed cap min(4 GiB, physical_memory/4) as Stage 11; no replacement on failure

selection.objective: maximize smaller gain across the two splits
selection.remaining_exact_tie: retain Stage 9 rather than invent another rule
selection.tie_break_2: lower measured computational cost summed across splits: shared EASE fit/score plus direct fusion

splits: unchanged Stage 8 horizon12 and original10 users, labels, pools, boundaries and evaluation rules
uncertainty: overlapping, repeatedly used historical periods; selection-unadjusted descriptive intervals, not independent confirmation
